## Context

- D153 L3 requires every objection window to be committed as .mob/records/decisions/NNN-<slug>.json with its proposal, each seat's role, model, context, answer, start time and probe reference. L3b asked for a checker rule that enforces the fields and could not land in the D153 commit itself (D145 C2), so it is this card, the next after 205. Until it is on main the external auditor checks windows by hand against the same fields.
- The directory .mob/records/decisions/ does not exist yet; with no windows the check must pass, so the rule starts doing work with the first window.
- Left to other cards: the L3a trail order and any rule that a window should have been a full Decider.
- The change records in this repository with D153 in the commit subject (D145 C2), a failing fixture committed before the rule (D153 L3b) and red test first (D137), under the D136 limits (at most 15 countable files and 400 changed lines per commit).
